question: On a FRESH 24-item invention-shaped holdout, does the SHIPPED recipe (best-of-N + critique + revise + deterministic verifier) beat a COMPUTE-MATCHED single-shot baseline on wins+ties with a Wilson 95% CI LOWER BOUND > 50%?

arms.generator_both_arms: agnes-3.0-flash direct API (AGNES_BASE_URL; 2-key rotation; 4x120s backoff), identical prompts/temperature/max_tokens; both arms spend exactly 6 generator calls per item (compute-matched)
arms.baseline: 6 INDEPENDENT plain single-shot draws; champion = longest draw (the r176 selector, unchanged); NO critique, NO revise, NO verifier
arms.pipeline_shipped: 4 plain draws -> critique -> revise (6 calls) -> DETERMINISTIC VERIFIER: typed rejection when the revised text lacks any falsification-test span OR contains a citation-like pattern (DOI / patent number / author-year); on rejection, fall back to the longest plain draw and record the typed reason. The verifier is never disabled (the kill criterion shipped it as the production path).

judging.seat: tr-deepseek (deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-free via TOKENROUTER) — the only live seat measured this session (ctai 429/burned, snlite xkiro-quota-blocked); judge family != generator family (Art. 26)
judging.protocol: blind two-pass, order-swapped (XY/YX), structured VERDICT line; WIN only on both-pass agreement for the pipeline; otherwise TIE or LOSS; parse failures typed, no re-rolls
judging.wins_plus_ties: WIN or TIE counts; LOSS does not
judging.machine_scores_are_input: the machine judgment is the pre-registered instrument for this gate; the auditor recomputes independently from raw pair bytes (Art. 13)

gate_score4.power_note: at n=24 the Wilson lower bound exceeds 0.50 at >=17/24 wins+ties; pre-registered, not negotiated after the run
gate_score4.secondary: 0 fabricated citations in pipeline outputs (citation-pattern scan); typed verification record per item

one_shot_integrity.no_tuning: no prompt, selector, verifier or judge change between items; no re-rolls; typed infra failures recorded
one_shot_integrity.byte_resume: per-item pair bytes; a relaunch resumes and never re-runs a completed item
one_shot_integrity.burn: plaintext destroyed after the run; ciphertext/hashes and pair bytes remain as the auditable record
